# SILKDEV

> SILKDEV (Silkdev-SUARL, matricule fiscal 1782006M) is an AI development agency based in Bizerte, Tunisia. We design, engineer, and ship software end to end — web apps, AI agents, knowledge systems, and platforms — for clients in Tunisia and worldwide. "If it can be done, it will be done."

Every project starts with an AI intake chat on the website; active clients get a portal with a project planner, notifications, and an AI project representative that remembers their preferences. Services are scoped individually and quoted at a fixed price — no public price list.

The site is available in English and French (Arabic was removed — existing /ar URLs redirect to French).

## Services

1. Web Development & Design — sites that convert, platforms that scale. React/Next.js, e-commerce, SaaS, SEO, internationalization.
2. AI Support Agents — customer support on WhatsApp, web chat, and email in Arabic, French, and English, 24/7, with human handoff.
3. Custom AI Features — semantic search, auto-tagging, summarization, and recommendations built inside existing products.
4. Knowledge & Document AI — PDFs, Notion, Drive, and wikis become a searchable, citation-grounded knowledge base (powered by SILKLEARN).
5. Workflow Automation — invoicing, lead routing, reporting, and CRM automation for the back office.
6. AI Strategy & Fractional CTO — technical leadership and AI adoption planning without a full-time hire.
